findings.downstream_effect: Moving ownership operations into generic interactive capacity can starve authentication, user requests and health checks. Nested company leases can create synchronized renewal bursts.

findings.downstream_effect: Continuing after a transient renewal error can let a suspended old worker run past actual lease expiry and race its replacement. A pre-write owner check has a race with takeover.
findings.required_constraint: Use the last confirmed valid lease deadline conservatively; stop on confirmed loss or expiry. Guard checkpoint mutations and the authoritative publication commit with current ownership. Retain existing Blob generation ordering and ETag conditions; SQL ownership checks alone do not fence Blob writes.

findings.downstream_effect: Per-company writes increase SQL load; independent latest pointers can expose mixed component versions. Faster companies can dominate visible coverage while difficult investigations remain pending.
findings.required_constraint: Persist completed work durably with stable task identity and controlled write concurrency. Publish a coherent artifact referencing its exact component versions and original observation dates. Preserve earlier useful results when refresh fails and give deferred work fair continuation.

findings.downstream_effect: Replacing NaN/Infinity with null can hide analytical data errors. Different normalization in identity hashing and storage can cause needless cache misses or inconsistent reuse.
findings.required_constraint: Use one canonical representation for persistence and relevant cache identity, retain raw inputs/provenance and distinguish data-quality errors from ordinary missing values. Never turn missing values into numeric zero.

findings.downstream_effect: An independent cleanup allowance can accidentally restart the job clock or permit an expired owner to publish. Secondary logging failures can still replace the originating exception.
findings.required_constraint: Keep finalization inside the original total deadline; separate audit recording from permission to mutate research or publish. Preserve original failure and attach secondary recording outcomes separately.

findings.downstream_effect: Reserving more completion time reduces acquisition time. Restoring Pro reviews increases cost and can activate inherited memory writing; repeated review may spend money without useful changes.
findings.required_constraint: Keep full evidence and analytical capability. Use one explicit review owner per artifact, checkpoint completed stages and reuse compatible accepted review results. Judge complete output quality, acquisition coverage, latency and cost together.

controls.max_cost_usd: Nonnegative finite USD target; 10 to 1000+ supported continuously. Blank or zero on a scheduled producer selects the configured best-effort model. A positive funded target protects full-model core work even when optional headroom is exhausted.

controls.concurrency: Independent capacity limits for model calls, acquisition, browsers and database work; money alone does not increase them.

adaptive_behavior: The shared LLM planner sees optional headroom, protected core funds, actual/reserved spending, model/tool prices and remaining time. Greater targets permit more useful exploration, not compulsory spending.

The news producer declares all selected company writing and current-event interpretation obligations before optional research starts. The shared agent protects writing/review before its own planning, and core gateway calls preserve the configured full model.

Optional acquisition cannot consume completion funds. Core requests move protected money into in-flight reservations atomically with applicable provider credit. Settling returns unused funds to the obligation; completing its owning result releases the remainder.

If no funded target exists, use the configured cheapest suitable model to synthesize this run’s current inputs. A short window stops optional deep research; it does not downgrade funded core calls or queue a news story for another day.

Use actual source/event/observation dates throughout. Completed company background can be reused with its original date. A new run cannot inherit an unfinished investigation’s old as-of date, and current news is not merged with older interpretation rows.

accounting.available: Target minus settled charges, in-flight/unknown reservations and unspent protected core obligations. Moving protected funds into an actual request does not count them twice. Provider-account credit remains separately enforced.
accounting.atomicity: Coordinate account affordability and run allowance reservations so failure in one cannot leak the other reservation.
accounting.retry: A replica retry retains the original logical run identity, spending, reservations and deadline without changing model policy.
accounting.paid_tools: Include incremental paid inference and acquisition; rented compute requires allocation-wide reservation. Fixed shared hosting is reported separately rather than silently represented as per-request spend. Unpriced paid actions need a bounded quote before admission.
accounting.changes: Initial target is retained across replica recovery. Audited owner amendments retain all incurred/reserved obligations. Changing the configured target does not reset spending.

reuse_and_depth: Preserve complete captured inputs and completed research stages independently of the allowance used to obtain them. Increasing the requested budget/depth should extend useful work rather than discard it.

A cheaper completed answer is retained input for a deeper investigation, not automatic proof that the deeper objective is complete. The shared LLM assesses achieved scope and worthwhile remaining questions.

Cache compatibility follows evidence, requested analytical scope, effective model/prompt/schema and permissions. A worker-count or dollar-ceiling change alone must not invalidate unchanged completed input artifacts.

funding_order.stage: Inspect retained work and current changes
funding_order.behavior: Build one shared inventory of retained findings, full sources, dates, material changes and unresolved questions. Charge planning and materiality assessment to the run. Use this to avoid purchasing the same company/event/source investigation independently for several consumers.

Fund the writing and required review of every admitted investigation, plus required aggregate composition/finalization. Quote against actual model, bounded context/output and declared completion stages. Enlarge this obligation before admitting a scope/context increase. Reserve dollars and time independently; no fixed percentage guarantees completion.

The shared LLM planner ranks worthwhile questions using task importance, material changes, uncertain claims, counterevidence, existing coverage, shared dependencies and expected incremental usefulness. It proposes bounded work and the completion obligations it creates. Budget amounts are constrained by ledger arithmetic; research priorities are not hardcoded.

Grant each investigation enough for a useful next stage and its finish obligation. All grants share the parent allowance and usable provider credit. Available worker count is a capacity ceiling; unfunded investigations wait. A grant expiring or needing more funds triggers checkpoint/reallocation, never permission to consume the remaining parent pool.

At material findings, contradictions, completed stages or an exhausted grant, reassess which next work most improves the objective. Return unused grant funds and expand promising investigations. Preserve room for important uncertain questions rather than selecting only cheap easy requests. Reuse the existing planner and reallocate at useful milestones; coordination costs are included.

Finish funded core work on the configured full model, allowing a small recorded completion overrun; publish current completed results. Replica recovery retains this run’s original identity, clock and spending. A later scheduled run starts current research, not an unfinished prior news investigation.

ledger_contract.invariant: target + recorded commitment excess = settled charges + in-flight/unknown reservations + unspent protected core obligations + nonnegative free headroom. A protected amount moves into its request reservation once, then unused request headroom returns to its obligation until completion.
ledger_contract.no_double_counting: Starting a funded request atomically moves funds from its grant/completion hold into an in-flight reservation; it does not reserve those dollars a second time. Settlement debits actual/bounded cost and returns unused headroom.
ledger_contract.admission: Commit run allowance, allocation authority and applicable provider-account affordability together. Remote planning/price queries occur outside the SQL transaction.
ledger_contract.completion_growth: Core completion retains the configured full model under a positive target. Quote/context growth and small completion overruns are recorded; optional research cannot borrow these funds. Blank/zero targets use economical current reporting.
ledger_contract.handoff: Reclaim unspent grants only with fenced allocation authority. In-flight and unknown paid attempts remain obligations after worker loss; reconciliation, not lease expiry alone, releases them.
ledger_contract.amendments: An explicit owner amendment retains spending, outstanding requests and all protected/granted funds. An ordinary retry or configuration change cannot increase the retained allowance.

model_use.economy: Eligible bounded extraction, evidence organization, duplicate/materiality assessment and intermediate summaries; originals and dates remain available.
model_use.full: Material interpretation, competing explanations, numerical assumptions requiring substantive reasoning, consequential synthesis and required review. Escalate economy work when substantive ambiguity warrants the cost.
model_use.measurement: Route suitability and completion quotes must be calibrated on complete retained-source outputs and actual attempt costs; no claim that cheap routing or more spending guarantees quality.

scaling_examples.ten_dollars: Protect current core interpretation/writing/review first. Use economical planning/organization and reusable dated context; reduce optional exploration to the remaining allowance. Do not carry old stories into the next briefing.
scaling_examples.one_thousand_plus: Permit more eligible investigations, fuller primary-source acquisition, alternative explanations, numerical scenarios and additional useful checking, within the same configured time and physical capacity.
scaling_examples.not_tiers: These illustrate expected behavior, not coded dollar thresholds, source counts or compulsory spending.
